tasks.gr8-visual-arts-t3: Topic: Visual Arts. Cover South African and African art, symbolism, mixed media, and visual literacy. Ask Grade 8 learners to interpret meaning in artworks, identify symbolic choices, and plan mixed-media responses linked to theme and context.
tasks.gr8-music-t3: Topic: Music. Cover binary and ternary form, composition basics, ostinato, and listening analysis. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify musical form, analyse repeated patterns, and choose effective composition decisions in short examples.
tasks.gr8-drama-t3: Topic: Drama. Cover characterisation, conflict, staging, scripted dialogue, and rehearsal. Ask Grade 8 learners to select character choices, evaluate scene conflict, and recognise staging and rehearsal practices that improve performance quality.
tasks.gr8-dance-t3: Topic: Dance. Cover space, energy, choreographic devices, cultural dance study, and performance quality. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify choreographic devices, explain energy and space choices, and evaluate movement sequences with clear dance vocabulary.
tasks.gr8-ca-ostinato-jingle-t3: Topic: Melodic ostinato, riffs, lyrics and the jingle. Cover an ostinato as a short repeated pattern (rhythmic on African drums, melodic with pitches), a riff, writing four lines of lyrics about a personal or social issue, a jingle of about one minute that advertises a product or service (beats and bars at a tempo in 4/4), and music technology (recording layers in music software). Ask Grade 8 learners to count notes in repeated patterns, calculate beats and bars of a jingle and explain the terms.
tasks.gr8-ca-polished-improvisation-t3: Topic: Polished improvisation in a style. Cover choosing a style (comedy, tragedy, musical, puppet show), using the drama elements (what, who, where, when, who to, beginning-middle-end, climax, tension), technical resources (properties, set pieces, costume pieces, basic lighting, sound, improvised or self-made) and justifying the use of resources with a reason. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify styles and resources and to choose the best justification.
tasks.gr8-ca-careers-decoration-t3: Topic: Careers in arts and design and surface decoration. Cover careers (graphic designer, illustrator, photographer, interior designer, art teacher), researching a career from several sources (books, the library, interviews, the internet) and presenting it, surface decoration in fashion design, interior design and corporate design, and 2D and 3D construction techniques (pasting, cutting, modelling, wrapping, tying, stitching, joining, scoring) with safe tool use. Ask Grade 8 learners to match careers and fields and choose good research and craft practice.
tasks.gr8-ca-dance-careers-t3: Topic: Dance careers and discussing a dance you have seen. Cover discussing a dance seen in the community, on television or on stage (type of dance, movements, type of music, ideas or themes), the dance elements space (symmetry, asymmetry, patterning), force (strong and light) and active and passive relationships, careers in dance (dancer, choreographer, dance teacher, dance therapist, costume designer), and researching and presenting a dance career (skills, qualifications, qualities, description). Do not name real dances or dancers. Ask Grade 8 learners to describe a dance and match careers and research steps.
